channel.description: Latest articles from SCC Online Web Edition (scconline.com)

item.title: Bombay High Court declines to intervene in Cox & Kings’ arbitration, says remedy lies under Section 34 Arbitration Act
item.description: “Only in rare and exceptional cases, where it is ex-facie evident the Arbitral Tribunal has passed an order patently illegal or perverse, or exercised power wholly without jurisdiction, interference from the writ court is warranted.” The post Bombay High Court declines to intervene in Cox & Kings’ arbitration, says remedy lies under Section 34 Arbitration Act appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: AIBE-XX Results Declared: 69.21% Pass Rate, Next Exam on June 7, 2026
item.description: BCI has announced the AIBE XX results with a 69.21% pass rate and confirmed that the next AIBE exam will be held on June 7, 2026, with registration starting on February 11. The post AIBE-XX Results Declared: 69.21% Pass Rate, Next Exam on June 7, 2026 appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Lakshmikumaran & Sridharan Attorneys advises BlueScope Steel on Cross-Border Sale of Indian JV Stake to Tata Steel
item.description: Lakshmikumaran & Sridharan Attorneys advised BlueScope Steel Limited on the cross-border sale of its Indian joint venture stake to Tata Steel Limited in a transaction valued at approximately INR 1,100 crore. The post Lakshmikumaran & Sridharan Attorneys advises BlueScope Steel on Cross-Border Sale of Indian JV Stake to Tata Steel appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Delhi HC holds Sending case to Successor Judge for re-hearing after conclusion of final arguments and reservation of judgment contrary to right to speedy trial
item.description: Justice delayed is justice denied, and any attempt to prolong proceedings by reopening arguments after the matter stood closed and reserved for pronouncement of judgment is liable to be held vitiated in law. The post Delhi HC holds Sending case to Successor Judge for re-hearing after conclusion of final arguments and reservation of judgment contrary to right to speedy trial appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: ‘No willful disobedience or non-compliance’: Delhi HC rejects Meta’s claim for additional damages in Facebake v. Facebook trade mark case
item.description: “Where judgment debtors have substantially complied with a permanent injunction and no prior notice of breach was issued, execution proceedings cannot be used to seek additional compensation.” The post ‘No willful disobedience or non-compliance’: Delhi HC rejects Meta’s claim for additional damages in Facebake v. Facebook trade mark case appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Failure to videograph recovery weakens prosecution case: Allahabad HC Grants Bail, Directs UP DGP to issue SOP
item.description: “It is clear that police has not conducted any videography of the recovery of motorcycles from the applicant or preparation of list of seized motorcycles, though, same is mandatory.” The post Failure to videograph recovery weakens prosecution case: Allahabad HC Grants Bail, Directs UP DGP to issue SOP appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas Advises Devyani International on Sapphire Foods Merger
item.description: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas advised Devyani International Limited on the merger of Sapphire Foods India Limited with DIL, consolidating Yum! Brands’ India franchise under a single listed entity. The post Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas Advises Devyani International on Sapphire Foods Merger appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: President appoints Justice Manoj Kumar Gupta as Chief Justice of Uttaranchal High Court
item.description: On 18-12-2025, the Supreme Court Collegium led by CJI Surya Kant, recommended the elevation of Justice Gupta as Chief Justice of Uttaranchal High Court. The post President appoints Justice Manoj Kumar Gupta as Chief Justice of Uttaranchal High Court appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Kerala HC grants bail to 19-year-old accused in POCSO, IT Act case involving sharing minor girl’s nude images online
item.description: “The accusations against the accused were prima facie well-founded, particularly the allegation that he transmitted nude videos of the girl through social media. The Court observed that such conduct could not be viewed lightly.” The post Kerala HC grants bail to 19-year-old accused in POCSO, IT Act case involving sharing minor girl’s nude images online appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Call for Abstracts | National Conference on Recognition, Rights and Realities: Tribal Identity, Governance and Justice in Contemporary India| HPNLU Shimla
item.description: The Centre for Tribal and Cultural Studies, HPNLU Shimla, invites abstracts for a National Conference on “Recognition, Rights and Realities: Tribal Identity, Governance and Justice in Contemporary India”, to be held online on 28 March 2026. The post Call for Abstracts | National Conference on Recognition, Rights and Realities: Tribal Identity, Governance and Justice in Contemporary India| HPNLU Shimla appeared first on SCC Times.
